title: RouteDiscoveryBuildOptions
summary: Withhold protected routes from public browser output until the server authorizes them.

sections.title: Configuration
sections.body: protect decides which routes anonymous clients must not see; manifestFile is the private manifest for createRequestHandler, relative to the Vite root. Pass both to applicationPlugins({ routeDiscovery }).

sections.title: Scope
sections.body: Only production client builds withhold routes; development serves every route. A protected nested layout withholds its descendants. The manifest path must resolve outside client output and publicDir.
